items.title: 10.27 Winkler tareeqa, BOD aur DO (print mein 10.27) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the section printed as 10.27 with Figure 10.12, pages 239-240.

blocks.title: Biochemical oxygen demand (BOD)
blocks.text: BOD qudrati pani ke organic madde ki paanch din ki muddat mein oxygen kharch karne ki salahiyat hai. Us ki qeemat namoone mein hal shuda organic madde ke biological oxidation se kharch hone wali oxygen ki miqdar hai, aisa reaction jo pani mein pehle se maujood microorganisms catalyse karte hain. Yeh Winkler tareeqe se paanch din ki muddat ke shuru aur aakhir mein oxygen ki concentration se napi jati hai, jis doran band kiya hua namoona andhere mein 25 degrees C ke mustaqil darja hararat par rakha jata hai.

blocks.title: Dissolved oxygen (DO)
blocks.text: DO pani mein hal shuda oxygen ki miqdar hai, fiza se ya pani mein paudon ke photosynthesis se chhori hui. Us ki concentration 5 aur 8 mg fi dm3 ke darmiyan hoti hai; kam se kam darja 5 mg fi dm3 hona chahiye, aur is se neeche pani aalooda (polluted) samjha jata hai.
DO aur BOD ka ulta taalluq hai (Figure 10.12): jaise bacteria organic madda torte hue oxygen kharch karte hain, BOD barhti aur dissolved oxygen ka darja girta hai.

blocks.alt: Darya ke bahao ki simt ke muqable concentration ka graph. Dissolved Oxygen (thos lakeer) ooncha hai, achanak gir kar kam tareen hota hai aur phir aahista dobara ooncha ho jata hai. BOD (nuqta-dar lakeer) neecha hai, usi jagah tezi se chotti tak charhta hai aur phir aahista girta hai, DO ke curve ko kaat-ta hua.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.12: BOD aur DO ka ulta taalluq (kitab ki Figure 10.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jahan darya mein organic madda (maslan ganda pani) shamil hota hai, wahan bacteria use torne ke liye oxygen kharch karte hain: BOD tezi se barhta hai aur DO tezi se girta hai. Aage chal kar organic madda khatam hota hai to BOD ghat-ta hai aur hawa se oxygen ghulne par DO dobara barh jata hai. Kitab ki figure mein 'Disolved' chhapa hai; sahih hijje 'Dissolved' hain.

Winkler tareeqa pani ke namoonon mein dissolved oxygen napta hai. Yeh dissolved oxygen ki oxidising khasiyat par mabni hai, jo KI se react karti hai; bani hui iodine ko starch ko indicator bana kar sodium thiosulfate se titrate kar ke napa jata hai, jo end point dikhane ke liye solution ko gehra neela karta hai. Bani hui iodine ki miqdar solution mein dissolved oxygen ki miqdar ke mutanasib hai.

blocks.prompt: BOD napne ke liye Winkler tareeqe ka istemal aur BOD ka pani ki aaloodgi ka paimana hona wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation: Namoone ki DO foran Winkler iodine titration se aur phir 25 degrees C par andhere mein band paanch din ke baad napi jati hai; kami BOD hai. Organic aaloodgi un bacteria ko khurak deti hai jo oxygen kharch karte hain, to zyada BOD ka matlab bohat aalooda pani hai, aur DO ka 5 mg dm-3 se neeche girna aabi hayat ko nuqsan deta hai.

items: BOD: organic madde ke microbial oxidation se 5 din mein kharch oxygen (band, andhera, 25 degrees C). DO: 5 se 8 mg dm-3, 5 se neeche aalooda; BOD aur DO ulte badalte hain.
Winkler: hal shuda O2 KI ko I2 mein oxidise karti hai; sodium thiosulfate se titrate, starch gehra neela hota hai; bani iodine DO ke mutanasib.
